newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 241 OF SEPTEMBER 21, 1996.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 241 OF SEPTEMBER 21, 1996.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

Corrigendum to Council Regulation (EC) No 1628/96 of 25 July 1996 relating to aid for Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia and the former Yugoslav Republic of Macedonia (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 204 of 14 August 1996)
DECISION No 163 of 31 May 1996 concerning the interpretation of Article 22 (1) (A) of Regulation (EEC) No 1408/71 in respect of persons undergoing dialysis or oxygen therapy (96/555/EC)
DECISION No 162 of 31 May 1996 concerning the interpretation of Articles 14 (1) and 14b (1) of Council Regulation (EEC) No 1408/71 on the legislation applicable to posted workers (96/554/EC)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1828/96 of 20 September 1996 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1827/96 of 20 September 1996 providing for the opening and management of a tariff quota for preparations of a kind used in animal feeding falling within CN codes 2309 90 31, 2309 90 41 and 2309 90 51
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1826/96 of 20 September 1996 on the supply of milk products as food aid
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1825/96 of 20 September 1996 opening intervention in accordance with Article 6 (4) of Council Regulation (EEC) No 805/68
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1824/96 of 20 September 1996 amending Regulation (EEC) No 1627/89 on the buying in of beef by invitation to tender
COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 1823/96 of 16 September 1996 opening and providing for the administration of autonomous Community tariff quotas for certain fishery products (second series 1996)
COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 1822/96 of 16 September 1996 opening and providing for the administration of Community tariff quotas for certain fishery products originating in Ceuta (1996-1997)

COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 1821/96 of 16 September 1996 amending for the sixth time Regulation (EEC) No 1866/86 laying down certain technical measures for the conservation of fishery resources in the waters of the Baltic Sea, the Belts and the Sound

COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 1820/96 of 16 September 1996 adopting autonomous and transitional measures for the free trade agreements with Lithuania, Latvia and Estonia in certain processed agricultural products

COMMISSION DECISION of 22 July 1996 on the conclusion of an Agreement between the European Coal and Steel Community and the Government of the Republic of Kazakhstan on trade in certain steel products (96/548/ECSC) END OF DOCUMENT.
